ambient_events: A tanker's air-brake lets go somewhere down the line with a hiss, though nothing has moved here in years.
Grit pings off the guardrail in a gust, then goes still.
description: Six lanes of freight road run west out of Old Coldwater, expansion joints heaved into knee-high ridges by decades of frost. Dead haulers sit nose-to-tail in the breakdown lane, cabs stripped to the frame, waiting on a shift change that never came.
name: The Haul Road
